newsitem.title: PERU: IADB says to loan $400 mln to Peru in 1997.
newsitem.headline: IADB says to loan $400 mln to Peru in 1997.

text.p: Inter American Development Bank (IADB) President Enrique Iglesias said his organization would loan a total $400 million to Peru in 1997 for a variety of education, health, highway and business projects.
This would follow the $800 million loaned to Peru this year for similar projects, Iglesias said at a business conference in the southern city of Arequipa.
"We are adding our grain of sand to the construction of the country," he said.
Iglesias said the loans to Peru were at "very cheap" interest rates of 6.70 percent per year. He did not give details on their maturity.
